rows.grounds: genitive of sādhaka indicating the one whose presence is approached
verb of motion expressing arrival or approach
locative of sannidhi denoting proximity or presence
past passive participle qualifying jana as wished for
subject who comes into the practitioner's presence

items.question: Who approaches the practitioner as a result of the prescribed worship?
premises: The practitioner has performed the prescribed worship.
A particular person is desired by the practitioner.
That desired person comes into the practitioner's presence.
items.inference: The prescribed worship results in the desired person approaching the practitioner.
items.plain_english: The desired person comes into the presence of the practitioner.
